name: SD Worx
verdict: SD Worx is 77.5% owned by WorxInvest, a holding entirely owned by the Belgian cooperative SD Worx for Society, itself held by two private foundations; CVC Strategic Opportunities II holds a minority stake. Nothing found.
note: Belgian HR/payroll services company; title sponsor of Team SD Worx-Protime. Rating note (issue #472, 2026-10-03): chain traced to WorxInvest (77.5%) -> cooperative SD Worx for Society -> private foundations SD and SD Patrimonium; CVC Strategic Opportunities II minority (22.5%) since June 2023. No state owner; no human-rights finding against SD Worx, WorxInvest or CVC found. 'none'.
